articles.title: GTA 6’s Long Wait Has People Realizing Their Own Mortality
articles.title_tr: GTA 6’s Long Wait Has People Realizing Their Own Mortality
articles.summary:
You might expect people to talk about the visuals, lighting, action sequences, or gunplay after Grand Theft Auto VI's brand-new extended-look trailer showed off over 25 minutes of new footage. But the top comments on Rockstar's YouTube upload of the video deal more with the human condition than expected. In fact, there's quite a bit of talk about death and remembrance.



The top comment (at the time of publication) states: "a moment of silence for people that didn't make it here." Meanwhile, another person writes: "Objective: Stay alive till release day." It's been a long wait for GTA 6, especially since GTA 5 originally launched almost 13 years ago. 


	
		
	
		


Not only has a lot happened to the gaming industry as a whole since GTA 5 came out, but also to people's personal lives. For instance, another person typed: "Bro, I went through middle school, high school, and college ... now I need to request time off work for this." Tragedy has apparently struck others, but not dampered their spirits, as seen in this comment: "I was in a traffic accident in February and lost a leg, but I've still got my two damn hands and my eyes, baby!"



There is a lot to take in from the new GTA 6 trailer, such as NPCs noticing if you're openly carrying a weapon in the game. In addition, stealing a car might be a little more complicated this time around. For older vehicles, you can still smash the glass, but newer models apparently require a key cloner. 



GTA 6 is set to finally release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It sounds like a playthrough of the open-world game could be roughly 80 hours, so plan accordingly this holiday season.

articles.title: GTA 6 Lets You Throw Dog Poop At People
articles.title_tr: GTA 6 Lets You Throw Dog Poop At People
articles.summary:
A very important piece of news has come to light about GTA 6: You can pick up dog poop and throw it at people in the upcoming open-world crime game.



YouTuber TGG visited Rockstar North's offices and spoke with the team, and one of the things he learned was how dog poop can be a weapon. 



"If someone is out on the street and they're walking their dog, and the dog takes a dump, you can wait for the person to pick up the dog sh** with a doggie bag, and then you can hit that person, making them drop that doggie bag full of dog crap, and then you can actually pick that up and throw it at people," he said.




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XpPpqZwUwl0




Throwing dog poop at people is not a nice thing to do, and presumably GTA 6's new Red Dead Redemption 2-like honor system will knock you for this, or at least we hope it would. GTA 6 also lets you pet dogs or scold them, and we're hoping anyone who scolds a very good boy also gets a ding to their honor.



One of the dogs in GTA 6.
